title: Objection, My Lord!
synopsis: A father burns himself alive outside the Hyderabad High Court, demanding justice for his missing daughter, Sameera. When the system moves on and forgets, one question remains.Did Sameera ever exist? A forgotten lawyer, Parshuram, is forced out of self imposed exile to fight for the answer.

title: Azadi 501
synopsis: A dramatization of one of India's largest tech scams, where millions of buyers were deceived by the promise of an impossibly cheap phone, leading to a nationwide fraud.

title: Jagamae Sangeetham
synopsis: Set in Vaikuntapuram, a sacred temple town nestled between the banks of the Godavari and the neon lights of pop stardom, a disciplined heir to a musical throne and a fame-weary singer strike a forbidden chord. To protect a century of heritage, they must navigate a landscape of family secrets, masked identities, and the heavy price of finding their own voices.
